questions.stem: What is the difference between irradiation and contamination?

options.text: Irradiation is exposure to radiation from an external source; contamination is when radioactive material gets on or into an object or person
Irradiation only applies to gamma rays; contamination applies to all types
Contamination is exposure to radiation; irradiation is when radioactive material is ingested

questions.explanation: Irradiation means being exposed to radiation from an external source. Once the source is removed, the exposure stops and the object does not become radioactive. Contamination means radioactive material is deposited on or inside an object or person, which continues to irradiate until the material is removed or decays.
